title: Check key health at startup and say what needs attention
goal: Zero-config means zero REQUIRED files or env vars: derive, detect or default; where only the human can supply something (a secret, a consent) ask once at the moment of need, never via a hand-edited file. Run the read-only key check in the background at startup and surface rejected or missing keys in 'susi status' with the fix command. Tests zc_keys_health_boot_*.
